name: chartkit-web
description: Public site for chartkit.dev. Static Astro app. Deploy apps/web/dist by hand.

scripts.paint: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/paint-dashboards.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/paint-surfaces.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/paint-batch3.ts
scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/core && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/geo && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/vanilla && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/convert && npm run paint
scripts.prebuild: npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/core && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/geo && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/vanilla && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/convert && npm run paint
scripts.precheck: npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/core && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/geo && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/vanilla && npm run build --workspace=@chartkitdev/convert && npm run paint
